fnd007.lead: SENAI is the source of truth for factory identity, licences and industrial data. Inspection Platform reads and reconciles — it never writes back.
fnd007.holds: holds: the agreed connection cannot write establishment records back.
fnd007.breach: breach: the agreed connection can now write records back. Stop and report it.
fnd007.snapshot: Observed-on-inspection snapshots are captured separately and never overwrite the source.

sources.help: Source data is view only. This list records which connections the app uses. Adding one does not mean it is connected.
sources.error: Source connections could not be read. The agreement and recorded calls are still available on their own.
sources.runsError: Recorded runs could not be read. Available connection settings are kept without a guessed freshness or counts.
sources.caption: Registered upstream source connections
sources.emptyBody: No source connection is registered. This is a checked, empty result, not a failure.
sources.footer: Record counts and freshness are shown only where a sync run recorded them. Nothing on this screen is estimated.
sources.footerUnavailable: Run freshness and counts are not available because the run source failed. Connection facts above remain readable.

endpoints.help: The documented read contract Inspection Platform is permitted to call. This is the same allow-list the runtime client enforces.
endpoints.callsError: We could not read the recorded live calls. The allowed list still shows, but we cannot confirm the calls. That is not the same as failing them.
endpoints.caption: SENAI connection agreement and recorded call checks
endpoints.blocked: forwarding is turned off; nothing is sent
endpoints.noCall: No live call recorded. Documented is not connected.
endpoints.verificationUnavailable: Live-call history could not be read.
endpoints.footer: Only recorded sync-call rows count as proof. If a call did not succeed, the Factory 360 section says it is not available. It never shows a made-up value. Any address outside this agreement is refused before the request leaves the server.

mapping.help: How SENAI fields map to internal fields, with transform and status.
mapping.heading: field mapping list
mapping.body: No field mapping is approved yet. There is nothing to show here. Do not add a mapping on this screen. It would change how we read the source data. Until a mapping is approved, the app uses its own rules. Fields with no rule show as a dash.

reconcile.runsError: Sync runs could not be read. Total row counts and freshness are not available; matching divergences below remain independent.
reconcile.connectionsError: Source connections could not be read. The source-validation count is not available; recorded run and divergence facts are preserved.
reconcile.error: Matching divergences could not be read. This is data that's not available, not a checked, empty divergence set.
reconcile.caption: Recorded matching divergences
reconcile.emptyBody: No unresolved divergence is recorded. This is a checked, empty result.
reconcile.footer: Differences are resolved by an approved action, not edited here. The app never overwrites a difference on its own. It never sends the result back to SENAI.
reconcile.openHistory: Open sync, staging and matching history
